title: Fuzzy Logic Controller
text: 评估模糊推理系统，输入 1 路、输出 5 路；按 {Data type} 指定信号数据类型；{FIS name} 指定要评估的模糊推理系统 mamfis object、{Design}、{Number of samples for output discretization} 输出模糊集中的点数、{Implement FIS as lookup table} 指定将 FIS 转换为查找表、{Number of input breakpoints (samples)} 查找表断点数量、{Fuzzified inputs (fi)} 启用 fi 输出端口、{Rule firing strengths (rfs)} 启用 rfs 输出端口、{Rule outputs (ro)} 启用 ro 输出端口、{Aggregated outputs (ao)} 启用 ao 输出端口、{Simulate using} 指定仿真模式 Interpreted、{Out of range input value} 指定输入超出范围时的诊断消息行为、{No rule fired} 指定没有规则触发时的诊断消息行为、{Empty output fuzzy set} 输出模糊集为空时的诊断消息行为，按实例取值。

ports.name: out
ports.summary: 去模糊化输出信号 scalar | vector

ports.name: rfs
ports.summary: 规则触发强度 column vector

ports.name: ao
ports.summary: 聚合输出 matrix | row vector

params.name: FIS name
params.values: 要评估的模糊推理系统 mamfis object | sugfis object | mamfistype2 object | sugfistype2 object | FIS file name in quotes | MAT file name in quotes

params.name: Design
params.values: 打开 Fuzzy Logic Designer button

params.name: Number of samples for output discretization
params.values: 输出模糊集中的点数 101 (default) | integer greater than 1

params.name: Data type
params.values: 信号数据类型 double (default) | single | fixed-point | expression

params.name: Implement FIS as lookup table
params.values: 将 FIS 转换为查找表 off (default) | on

params.name: Number of input breakpoints (samples)
params.values: 查找表断点数量 10 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Fuzzified inputs (fi)
params.values: 启用 fi 输出端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Rule firing strengths (rfs)
params.values: 启用 rfs 输出端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Rule outputs (ro)
params.values: 启用 ro 输出端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Aggregated outputs (ao)
params.values: 启用 ao 输出端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 仿真模式 Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation

params.name: Out of range input value
params.values: 输入超出范围时的诊断消息行为 warning (default) | error | none

params.name: No rule fired
params.values: 没有规则触发时的诊断消息行为 warning (default) | error | none

params.name: Empty output fuzzy set
params.values: 输出模糊集为空时的诊断消息行为 warning (default) | error | none
